budget_items.what_was_recorded: Director reported the Memory Café has been awarded several grants, with amounts printed for three of them, plus COA Gift Fund designations and Formula Grant funds (no amounts printed).

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Memory Café was not awarded a grant from Blue Cross Blue Shield; no figure printed.
